name: RB binding protein 8, endonuclease
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: RBBP8 encodes DNA endonuclease RBBP8. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in homologous recombination and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Jawad syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: RBBP8 encodes DNA endonuclease RBBP8. Based in part on similarity, HR is restricted to S and G2 phases of the cell cycle and preferentially repairs DSBs resulting from replication fork collapse. It is a key determinant of DSB repair pathway choice, as it commits cells to HR by preventing classical non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ). It specifically promotes the endonuclease activity of the MRN complex to clear DNA ends containing protein adducts: recruited to DSBs by NBN following phosphorylation by CDK1, and promotes the endonuclease activity of MRE11 to clear protein-DNA adducts and generate clean double-strand break ends.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Jawad syndrome (autosomal recessive).
